engaged_phase_necessary_bound.scope: Condizioni necessarie ottimistiche nella fase in cui il naso attraversa il foro posteriore e la boccola attraversa il tetto. Rotazione X e traslazioni Y/Z; non prova globale 6DOF, non prova che ogni percorso debba attraversare questa fase a 3 gradi. Prior restricted probe; local analytic condition only. Not a prerequisite phase for all possible trajectories.

derivation.rotation: R_x(alpha), positive angle raises rear and lowers front
derivation.k: dz-tan(alpha)*dy; optimistic necessary bound -0.4<=k<=0.4 at rear-bore mid-plane
derivation.maximization: roof_axis_y increases with dy; set dy at upper bound and inspect both k endpoints, linear in k
derivation.phase_condition: Bushing cylindrical section must traverse roof, without end-cap truncation. This condition holds at the tabulated 3deg/5deg optimistic endpoints. No claim for phases with bushing wholly below roof or for yaw/roll.

MASTER D14 reference cuts 0.244371 / 0.291500 mm, remaining 1.761170 mm; actual bearing geometry/hardware needed.

rear_rigid_contact.proof: Translation changes the gap offset, not its slope. Normals differ by 1 degree: full annular contact without a wedge, machining or verified deformation is impossible in this rigid model.
rear_rigid_contact.scope_limit: Does not prove every insertion path impossible; does not quantify plastic nut compliance.
rear_rigid_contact.machining_note: Geometric budgets only. Seats/strength/tool access need design approval; no machining applied.

encoder_stack.scope: Rigid nominal lower bound assuming full insertion. Actual press fit may stop sooner, increasing the gap. No shaft modified, cap replaced, or spacer selected.

compensation_examples.status: FOR REVIEW ONLY; no component, aperture or placement changed
compensation_examples.note: The 0.5 mm wedge minima are proposed manufacturing parameters, not source dimensions. Jack thread engagement, actual MASTER bearing area/hardware and strength remain unverified.

local_search.bounds: Translations +/-5 mm; roll/yaw +/-5 deg; five starts per pitch; 32 generators per section; USB mouth vertices in current minimum aperture
local_search.scope: Local engaged-bushing search, conservative bodies, nominal cylinders; negative optima are NOT a global infeasibility certificate. Negative generator_phase_min means the infinite-cylinder phase approximation is inapplicable there.

native_path_screen.scope: Interpolated local extraction candidates with translations, yaw, roll and pitch, reversible to insertion. Screened with complete aperture shell and existing jack/USB models. Not a global search or complete populated PCB certification.

first_rejected_sample.note: Positive intersection rejects this candidate. Negative volumes would be a kernel error, not clearance.
